d: The Analyst - HR Analytics & Reporting is responsible for collecting, analyzing, and interpreting HR data to provide actionable insights that support strategic workforce decisions. The role develops dashboards, workforce reports, and HR metrics while ensuring data accuracy, governance, and reporting consistency across all Human Capital functions.
q: Analyze workforce data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities related to talent acquisition, turnover, retention, performance, diversity, and employee engagement.
Conduct statistical and trend analysis to support Human Capital strategies and initiatives.
Provide data-driven recommendations to HR leadership and business stakeholders.
Support workforce planning through predictive and descriptive analytics.
Develop and maintain HR dashboards and scorecards using Power BI and other reporting tools.
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual HR reports for leadership, executive committees, and board-level presentations.
Monitor and report key HR metrics, including:
Automate recurring reports to improve efficiency and reporting accuracy.
Ensure integrity, accuracy, and consistency of HR data across HRIS and related systems.
Perform data validation, audits, and cleansing activities.
Support HR data governance, privacy, and compliance requirements.
Partner with HRIS and technology teams to enhance reporting capabilities.
Support testing and validation activities for HR system upgrades and enhancements.
Assist in defining reporting requirements for new HR initiatives and projects.
Collaborate with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, Organizational Development, Learning & Development, and other functions to understand reporting needs.
Translate complex data into clear insights and executive-ready presentations.
Respond to ad hoc data requests from leadership and business stakeholders.
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Statistics, Business Administration, Management Information Systems, Data Analytics, Economics, or a related field.
Professional certifications in HR Analytics, Power BI, or Data Analytics are preferred.
0-1 years of experience in HR Analytics, HR Reporting, HRIS, Workforce Planning, or a related analytical role.
Experience working with HR systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, Workday, or similar platforms.
Experience developing dashboards and executive reporting.

d: We are currently seeking passionate and dynamic Kitchen professionals who pride themselves on their ability to deliver extraordinary levels of customer service and provide creative solutions to our guests.
As a Chef de Partie you are responsible to take care of the daily food preparation and duties assigned to meet the set standard and qualities.
q: You should have a professional kitchen apprenticeship or chefs training course and previous experience in quality establishments along with good culinary skills. The ability to communicate well in English and a proven track of food preparation, presentation and preservation knowledge is an essential.
The ideal candidate will be positively spirited, passionate about food and committed to work together with the service team to deliver an amazing guest experiences every time.

You are a positive, dynamic, creative and dedicated team player with the ability to work in a multicultural environment and under difficult condition while possessing the following additional competencies
r: Prepare the daily mis en place and food production in different sections of the main kitchen or satellites
Coordinate daily tasks with the Sous Chef or Executive Chef
Follow the instructions and recommendations from the immediate superiors to complete the daily tasks
Ensure the highest standards and consistent quality in the daily preparation and keep up-to-date with the new products, recipes and preparation techniques
Instruct and lead subordinates through their daily requirements in food preparation and actively take part in setup and supervising of buffets and special functions
Coordinate and participate with other sections of requirements, cleanliness, wastage and cost control
Consult and check on daily requirements, functions and last minute events
Guide and train the subordinates on a daily basis to ensure high motivation and economical working environment

d: PMKConsult is an award-winning project, commercial and design management consultancy with offices in the UAE, KSA and the UK, with a project footprint that exceeds 4.5 million sqm and a project portfolio value exceeding USD $8 billion.

We’re proud of our strong company culture. We actively build a positive and collaborative working environment by bringing in people who encourage and support their teammates, take full ownership, proactively solve problems and focus on results.
q: 4+ years of experience within a project consultancy environment.
Proven experience delivering international projects for global clients, with the ability to manage projects across multiple locations, cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong track record in the delivery of commercial office fit-out projects for major corporate clients.
r: You will be an integral part of our Workplace Department, working closely with our Directors while leading your own project teams and acting as the primary client contact across a portfolio of commercial office projects. You will lead the setup and delivery of multiple fit-out projects across the region, taking overall responsibility from initial due diligence and project definition through to procurement, construction, handover and close-out. This will include design and procurement management, programme management, client reporting, site observation, contract administration and overall client relationship management.

As the senior client lead, you will also support the wider account management of the portfolio, ensuring a consistent approach across projects and that PMK’s delivery model, governance processes and reporting standards are embedded across the teams. Given the regional nature of the portfolio, the role may require international travel to support project delivery and client requirements.

Working alongside our commercial and design teams, you will lead and coordinate external consultants, contractors and client stakeholders throughout both the pre- and post-contract phases. You will chair key project meetings, maintain clear ownership of actions and decisions, and manage the flow of information between all parties.

You will have overall ownership of project programmes, key deliverables and project controls, proactively identifying risks and driving the team to resolution. During construction, you will oversee site progress and quality, manage contractual and programme matters, and ensure the client has clear and timely visibility of project status, risks, decisions and required actions.
As a portfolio lead, you will be solely accountable for all facets of your projects.
